about: Arbor Metals Corp. identifies, acquires, and explores mineral resource properties in Canada. It explores for lithium and rare earth element deposits. The company holds a 100% interest in the Jarnet lithium project, which includes the Corvette Lake project. The Jarnet lithium project consists of 47 map-designated claims covering approximately 3,759 hectares, and the Corvette Lake project consists of 16 map-designated claims covering approximately 821 hectares, both located in the James Bay region of Quebec. It also holds a 100% interest in the Kemlee Lake lithium project, which covers an area of 1,500 kilometers located in the Georgia Lake Lithium Camp, Thunder Bay Mining Division, Ontario; and the Ernest rare earth element project, which consists of 34 claims covering approximately 1,844 hectares located in the Manicouagan region of Quebec. The company was formerly known as Vela Minerals Ltd. and changed its name to Arbor Metals Corp. in August 2019. Arbor Metals Corp. was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
